recognize_zh: 左圖周邊血中的單核細胞核圓、染色質粗塊、胞質少且深藍，外觀像小淋巴球，背景有棘狀紅血球（echinocytes）；右圖骨髓則是成片核偏位、有核周淡染區（perinuclear hof）的漿細胞，提示這些「淋巴球」其實是循環漿細胞（plasma cell leukemia）。
features: PB: small to medium mononuclear cells with round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm resembling mature lymphocytes
PB: numerous echinocytes (crenated red cells) and a disrupted smudged cell
BM aspirate: sheets of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and clock-face chromatin
BM: moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof in many cells
BM: near-complete replacement of normal hematopoiesis by plasma cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukocytosis composed largely of small to medium mononuclear cells with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm, closely mimicking mature lymphocytes; echinocytes and a smudged cell are also present. Bone marrow aspirate shows sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin, and perinuclear hofs, replacing normal hematopoietic elements. Because circulating cells lack an obvious hof, flow cytometry (CD45 negative, CD38/CD138 positive, kappa restricted) is required to establish their plasma cell lineage. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia mimicking chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are CD5/CD23/CD19/CD20 positive with dim surface light chain and smudge cells, whereas these cells are CD45 negative, CD38/CD138 positive, with sheets of plasma cells in the marrow.
LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with CD19/CD20 bright B cells and MYD88 L265P, rather than a monotonous CD45-negative plasma cell population.
Reactive plasma cells in sepsis are polytypic and rarely exceed a few percent in blood, unlike this monoclonal kappa-restricted population.
